name: Squat (Band)
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, stepping firmly onto the center of the resistance band with both feet.
Bring the handles up to shoulder height with palms facing forward, elbows raised slightly, and core braced.
Inhale and lower your hips down and back as if sitting into a chair, keeping your chest upright and knees tracking over your toes.
Descend until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Exhale and drive through your heels and mid-foot to stand back up against the band resistance to the starting position.
coaching_cues: Keep chest upright and do not allow the band tension to pull your shoulders forward
Drive knees outward in line with toes to prevent knee collapse
Maintain full foot contact with the floor throughout the movement
